resources.string: Reads the CamAPS FX screen while you use it, to record Boost, Ease-off, bolus calculator carbs and active insulin, and sends them to your Nightscout. It only reads CamAPS FX and never types or changes anything. The one exception is optional and off by default: if you turn on \"Open the Bolus tab when an app asks\" in FX Watcher, it taps CamAPS\'s Bolus tab once when an app such as Meal Log asks.
Hear about each bolus FX Watcher records (units, carbs and time), if sharing is turned on in FX Watcher.
